title: aizawa attractor
notes: 100k particles integrated through the Aizawa system (6 parameters: a=0.95, b=0.7, c=0.6, d=3.5, e=0.25, f=0.1). Distinct shape: a vortex disk with a central spike protruding upward — nothing like the Lorenz butterfly in zs4. Pointer X nudges 'a', pointer Y nudges 'c'. Emerald → violet → silver palette along orbit position. Slow auto camera orbit reveals the 3D form.
